method.nbm: Operational pairing: 00Z NDFD reference -> preceding 13Z NBM, 12Z NDFD reference -> preceding 01Z NBM. Actual NBM forecast age = NDFD lead + 11h.
method.ndfd: Historical NWS WMO archive, last issuance at/before reference time.
method.verification: URMA/RTMA 12-hour extrema are derived from complete hourly two-meter temperature analyses. Never present as native URMA TMIN/TMAX.
method.percentiles: QMD 00/06/12/18Z source cycles must be available before reference. 18h QMD is not verified using 12h URMA.
